messages.subject: ggplot2 documentation
parts:
Hi all,

I've just created a new mailing list, ggplot2-docs,
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2-docs, for discussion about
ggplot2 documentation. Over the next few weeks, I'll work with Jake
to write instructions to make it as easy as possible to help improve
the ggplot2 documentation. That way, as well as complaining about the
deficiencies, you can also help fix them ;)
